card.name: Female factor in creatinine clearance formula
card.fires_on: The space or multiplication sign right before the 0.85 factor for women in the Cockcroft-Gault creatinine clearance formula, after 'Females:' or 'multiplied by'.

modes.label: After Females label
modes.description: The blank space after 'Females:' just before the 0.85 multiplier in the formula.
modes.example: 72 × serum creatinine (mg/dL) Females:<< >>0.85 × above value Table

modes.label: Multiplication sign before 0.85
modes.description: The x sign in a female formula, placed just before 0.85.
modes.example: creatinine clearance (female) = (140-age)x body weight in kg<< x>> 0.85 72

card.writes: It promotes the words correction and adjustment, suggesting the next number is a correction factor applied to the result.
card.plain: It marks the spot in the kidney-function formula where the female correction factor of 0.85 comes next.
